examples.text: John blacked out at the halfway point of the marathon.

examples.text: I was already halfway home when I missed my keyring.

examples.text: It's about halfway between New York and Chicago.

examples.text: He caught up with him halfway (there).
examples.translation: Τον πρόφτασε στα μισά του δρόμου.

examples.text: I'm afraid we're not even halfway there yet.

examples.text: Two of the runners gave up halfway through the course.

examples.text: We are halfway up the mountain.

examples.text: Open up the window halfway to air out the room.

examples.text: This only halfway explains what really happened.
